photographs.name: Newton · dated west elevation and roof services
photographs.notes: Commons record credits FlyingKoala, 5 January 2025, CC BY 4.0. Complete 960 × 720 preview inspected natively after the original image returned HTTP 429; the full 5712 × 4284 original was not inspected. Shows mottled west brick, narrow vertical strips, central / side panes, pale head panels, turquoise entry treatment, parapet rail, rooftop framed units and pale pipes. The adjacent tall white-finned volume is the Anita B. Lawrence Centre / former Red Centre west end beside Newton, corroborated by the FJC corner photograph and shared source boundary. The earlier Hilmer attribution is corrected; Hilmer is a separate building farther north. Exact bay / equipment counts, dimensions and current condition remain unverified. No photograph pixels copied into scene assets.

photographs.name: Newton · blank brick south end above new helium facility
photographs.notes: Entire university completed-project photo inspected natively. Newton's south end above the new silver enclosure is largely blank brown brick with a pale top edge and roof services. Removes the former invented central pale stripe / repeated end windows. This view distinguishes the existing Newton west wing from taller Old Main to the right; exact capture date and rear elevations are unverified. The new helium addition remains separately reconstructed. No source pixels copied.

photographs.observed: Entire 736 × 480 university image inspected again natively: mottled brown brick, narrow projecting strips, wide centre / narrow side panes, pale panels above the glazing, white entrance fascia, turquoise ramp treatment and grey rails. Historical source image / exact capture date unverified. Text logos, decorative graphics and branding are not copied.

streetView.observed: Native official panorama inspected at visible July 2015 date facing east. Tall ground windows with horizontal divisions, shorter upper windows, narrow side panes, pale head panels, deep brick strips, varied blinds, dark downpipes and planted street edge. Exact bay schedule, glazing dimensions and present-day condition not established; later university / 2025 photographs corroborate the broad facade character. No Street View pixels or 3D mesh copied.
